g.text: Material: 7075-T651 12 mm plate · Process: 3-axis CNC, 2 setups
Tolerances: load-cell pockets flat 0.02, M6/M4 per ISO 965 6H · Finish: hard anodise black (mask pockets)
Dimension from the STEP model; general tolerances per docs/09 §2. Break sharp edges 0.2–0.5 mm. Projection: isometric, hidden lines grey.
